summary: The calls support a cautious, highly manual first-property configuration: human-controlled applicant approval and lease generation, certified funds before move-in, tracked repayment agreements, agent-led tours, Zillow lead tracking, recurring inspections, and no dynamic pricing. SD is interested in AI and automation only when access, language, escalation, and audit controls are tightly governed. Several important items remain product/workflow requirements rather than catalog settings, especially AI guardrails, custom reporting, utility anomaly detection, marketing-photo visibility, and Zillow listing behavior.

settings.setting: Allow Units to be Held During the Application
settings.path: Setup >> Properties >> Leasing >> Application >> General >> Allow Units to be Held During the Application
settings.meaning: Submitting an application will not reserve the unit automatically while SD compares and completes review of active applicants.

options.effect: Allows an in-process application to hold a unit.
Keeps the unit from being automatically held during application review.

reasoning: SD wants to review more than one qualified applicant and does not want the first application to create an approval-like commitment.
Keeping the default supports their manual selection and approval process.
related: Change Unit and Rentable Item Status to Rented When
